title: Pinned Rust tool selection
responsibility: Resolves a Rust executable from the nearest declared toolchain and isolates child compilation from host compiler overrides.

inputs.name: pinnedToolchain.tool
inputs.description: Lowercase Rust tool name beginning with a letter and containing only letters, digits and hyphens.

inputs.name: pinnedToolchain.options
inputs.description: Optional working directory, environment and command runner. Defaults use the current directory, process environment and synchronous subprocess execution.

outputs.name: pinnedToolchain
outputs.description: Resolved executable and copied child environment with the pinned RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN, matching rustc path, cleared wrappers and toolchain directories prepended to PATH and library search paths.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown for an invalid tool name, absent/malformed nearest rust-toolchain.toml, invalid starting directory, unavailable rustup or unsuccessful/empty tool resolution.
